summary: All three blocking findings are valid and will be repaired in spec.json.

items.title: Non-base presets still resolve from bundled artifacts as built-ins
items.rationale: The spec must forbid non-base presets from being available solely through bundled src/official-plugins discovery; otherwise the sibling repository migration can still be bypassed.
items.evidence: spec-review finding explains that PRESETS_DIR points at officialPresetPluginRoot()/presets and may merge bundled non-base presets into PRESETS without an enabled plugin.

items.title: Official upgrade path is not tied to the committed sibling source
items.rationale: The spec must require official install/upgrade to copy from a clean, commit-pinned sibling Git source, not from a dirty working tree or bundled fallback.
items.evidence: spec-review finding identifies ensureOfficialPackage and officialPackageCommit behavior as able to copy sourceRoot directly and fall back to a zero SHA.

items.title: Workflow plugin artifact lacks an execution acceptance basis
items.rationale: Manifest/path validation alone can pass while the installed workflow command fails at runtime due to package-relative import paths.
items.evidence: spec-review finding identifies the existing ../../../lib/cli.js import path as valid only from src/official-plugins and not from .senti/plugins/workflow/commands/workflow.js.
